title: CRUD-Style Abstract Interface Contracts (Storage Engine Spill)
pattern: Designing domain interface contracts using generic database CRUD operations rather than application-specific, atomic business actions.
why_bad: Information leakage. The contract betrays the underlying resource as a database. If the resource changes to a file or cloud-based queue, the interface becomes useless.
detection: Interface traits containing only `insert`, `select`, `delete`, `update` operations matching raw database verbs.
counterexample: General-purpose libraries or raw ORM wrapper traits. Mark as `Context-dependent`.
